# `rulemaking_lifecycles`

Legacy proposed-to-final timing rollup over regulations.gov documents. `proceedings` is the first-class identity/stage surface; this table remains published for existing duration and stuck-proposal consumers.

- **Parquet file:** `rulemaking_lifecycles.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | `pair` for a completed proposed-to-final sequence or `stuck` for a proposal with no later final rule. |
| `docket_id` | `VARCHAR` | Regulations.gov docket identifier. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Agency code from the proposed-rule document. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Representative proposed-rule title. |
| `proposed_date` | `DATE` | Earliest proposed-rule posted date in the docket. |
| `final_date` | `DATE` | Earliest final-rule date at or after the proposal; null for `stuck` rows. |
| `days` | `BIGINT` | Elapsed days from proposal to final rule; null for `stuck` rows. |
